column2: Mix the flour, yeast and water and knead a soft dough with olive oil.
Add the chopped olives and thyme and leave the dough to rise.
Shape small rolls and place on a tray.
Bake at 190°C until cooked inside and the crust is golden.
Purslane cacık with walnuts and garlic
Wash the purslane in plenty of water and dry
Whisk the yogurt with crushed garlic
Toss the purslane with the yogurt
Add olive oil and walnuts on top and serve cold.
Baked zucchini mücver
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the liquid well
Add the egg, flour, crumbled cheese and dill
Spread the mixture in a greased baking dish
Bake at 180°C for about 30 minutes until cooked inside and golden on top.
Bulgur salad with roasted eggplant
Soak the bulgur in hot water and cover to let it swell
Roast the eggplants, peel and chop them
Finely chop the tomato and parsley
Toss all the ingredients with olive oil and lemon.
Köfte soup with egg-yogurt liaison
3 tablespoons rice
Knead the mince, washed rice and grated onion and make small köfte
Bring the water to a boil with the carrot, add the köfte and cook completely
Whisk the yogurt, egg yolk and lemon and temper by adding hot liquid little by little
Stir the liaison into the pot and heat for a few more minutes.
Baked köfte with mushrooms
400 g minced meat
Knead the mince, grated onion, egg and breadcrumbs
Shape the köfte and arrange in a baking dish
Mix the sliced mushrooms with oil and thyme and spread them in between
Bake at 190°C until the köfte are fully cooked inside.
Chard with chickpeas in tomato sauce
1 bunch chard
Wash the chard thoroughly and chop it together with the stems
Soften the onion in oil and add the grated tomato
Put the chard, chickpeas and water in the pot
Cook over low heat until the chard is soft.
Baked lemon turkey
500 g turkey breast
Slice the turkey to an even thickness
Toss with lemon juice, oil, garlic and thyme
Place in a baking dish together with carrot slices
Bake at 190°C until the turkey is fully cooked, then let rest.
Red lentil vegetable patties
3 tablespoons oat flour
Boil the lentils until soft and drain
Grate the carrot and zucchini and squeeze out the excess liquid
Mix the lentils, vegetables, egg and oat flour and shape
Bake on baking paper at 190°C until both sides are golden.
Baked borlotti beans with tomato
Soften the onion and garlic in oil
Add the grated tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes
Mix the cooked beans with the sauce and water in a baking dish
Bake at 180°C for about 25 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Broccoli cheese soup
60 g grated kashar
Boil the onion and diced potato in water
Add the broccoli florets and soften all the vegetables
Blend the soup and add the milk
Heat over low heat and stir in the kashar until melted.
Chicken soup with tomato and vermicelli
200 g chicken breast
Cook the chicken through in water and shred it
Grate the tomatoes and cook in oil for a few minutes
Add the chicken stock, vermicelli and shredded chicken
When the vermicelli is soft, serve with lemon juice.
Erişte with zucchini and yogurt
Boil the erişte for the time on the packet and drain
Grate the zucchini and cook in oil until the liquid evaporates
Mix the yogurt with crushed garlic
Combine the erişte with the zucchini and yogurt and sprinkle with mint.
Baked couscous with vegetables
Cut the vegetables into small cubes
Mix the vegetables with oil and soften in the oven at 190°C
Cook the couscous in hot water according to the packet
Toss the cooked couscous with the oven vegetables.
Lentil pilaf with caramelised onions
1 cup bulgur
Boil the lentils so they stay firm and drain
Slice the onions thinly and brown them in oil over low heat
Add the bulgur, lentils and hot water
Cook until absorbed and let rest with the onions.
Baked apple oats
1 cup rolled oats
Cut the apples into small cubes
Mix the oats, milk, egg and cinnamon
Add the apples and walnuts and pour into a small baking dish
Bake at 180°C for about 25 minutes until set in the middle.
Peppers stuffed with lor cheese
4 small kapia peppers
Halve the peppers and remove the seeds
Mix the lor, egg and chopped parsley
Fill the peppers with the mixture and drizzle with oil
Bake at 190°C until the egg is fully cooked.
Orange semolina pudding
1 cup semolina
Zest of 1 orange
Mix the milk, semolina and sugar in a pot
Thicken over medium heat, stirring constantly
Add the grated orange zest and butter
Divide into bowls and serve once cooled.
Crumbly tahini walnut cookies
Mix the tahini and powdered sugar
Add the flour, baking powder and finely chopped walnuts to make a dough
Shape small balls and arrange on a tray
Bake at 170°C until lightly coloured, then let cool.
Baked cauliflower cheese balls
Steam the cauliflower until soft and drain well
Mash with a fork and mix with the egg, cheese and breadcrumbs
Make small balls and arrange on baking paper
Bake at 190°C until golden all over.
Hummus with roasted pepper
2 tablespoons tahini
Boil the chickpeas thoroughly and drain
Peel the roasted peppers
Blend the chickpeas, pepper, tahini, lemon and garlic until smooth
Adjust the consistency with water and serve with olive oil.
Baked chicken and vegetable skewers
Cut the chicken and vegetables into equal-sized pieces.
Toss with olive oil and thyme.
Thread the ingredients alternately onto skewers and place on a tray.
Bake at 200°C for about 25 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.
Beetroot salad with walnuts and yogurt
Once cooled, peel and grate them.
Add olive oil and walnuts on top.
Baked potatoes with spinach
250 g spinach
Slice the potatoes thinly and boil for 8 minutes.
Cook the spinach with the onion in a pan until the liquid evaporates.
Layer the potatoes and spinach in a baking dish.
Pour over the beaten egg and milk and bake at 190°C until fully cooked.
Cauliflower with chickpeas
Sauté the onion in oil and add the grated tomato.
Add the cauliflower, chickpeas and water.
Cook covered until the cauliflower is soft.
Salmon with lemon and dill
Place the salmon fillets in a baking dish.
Mix the lemon juice, oil and crushed garlic and brush over the top.
Bake at 180°C until the fish is fully cooked.
Serve with chopped dill.
Orzo pilaf with chicken
Cut the chicken small and cook it through in a pan.
Add the grated carrot and orzo and toast.
Add the hot water and cook covered over low heat.
When the water is absorbed, let rest for 10 minutes.
Baked zucchini with yogurt
Slice the zucchini into rounds.
Toss with oil and bake at 200°C until soft.
Mix the yogurt with garlic.
Top the lukewarm zucchini with yogurt and mint.
Cheese and leek börek
2 leeks
Half a tea glass milk
Finely chop the leeks and soften in oil.
Once cooled, mix with the crumbled cheese.
Divide the filling between the yufka sheets and roll up.
Brush with egg beaten with milk and bake at 190°C until golden.
Green lentil salad with bulgur
Soak the bulgur in hot water and wait for it to swell.
Chop the cucumber, pepper and parsley.
